svg.title: Metrics and independent LA tools feed fourfold nonvanishing, which combines with lifting to give fourfold abundance. Separately, LA good models feed Schnell.

a.aria-label: Theorems 1.1–1.2 · pp. 1–2: Identifies endpoint residual bundles with positive rational multiples of nef klt adjoints, supplying zero-Lelong metrics and interior injectivity. A nonzero section on the whole boundary additionally uses three-dimensional semi-dlt abundance and descent.
Lemmas 7.1–7.5 · pp. 45–52: Independent tools controlling centre degrees, moving multiplicities, slices, and finite covers of a fixed branch complement.
Theorem 9.1 · pp. 62–69: Rules out coexistence of the fixed jets, flag, and movable curve constructed in dimension four. This input is the independent Frobenius theorem, not LA’s abundance theorem.
Corollary 11.2 · pp. 73–74: Supplies a good minimal model, semiampleness, and effective exceptional comparison for a pseudo-effective canonical divisor.
Corollary 1.2 · p. 2: Provides the first section on the original variety; combined with the independent Theorem 1.2 to obtain fourfold log abundance.
